contentText: US Vice President JD Vance is scheduled to meet Denmark’s foreign minister and Greenland’s counterpart in Washington this Wednesday to discuss the Arctic island, a semiautonomous territory of Denmark, a NATO ally of the United States. On Tuesday, officials from Denmark and Greenland presented a united stance opposing former President Donald Trump’s previous ambitions to annex Greenland. Oliver Farry reports.
